notes.title: TAD: That Alien Dude v. 1.0.5 RELEASED!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32332559/441ab389bdc0db2ef16cbbcf2de96d3075fb5f86.gif

The Wait Is Over!

TAD: That Alien Dude has been released.  Currently in version 1.0.5, this premiere version of the game features updated dialog, original music, original animation, and a wacky storyline.

While not an "Early Access" release, please understand that you can expect TAD to evolve from here (and not via DLCs or via any other kind of paid content).  TAD is a work of love, and as such, the development will continue with criticism from the game community being taken very seriously. 

Changes from 1.0.0-4 to 1.0.5

* Fusionist level now has full walls and proper layering included
* Dialog boxes have been improved to match style of the game 
* Major bug wherein the game could not be completed if not completed on the first try by the player has been squashed
* Sound issues improved

Planned updates for upcoming releases

* Improved enemy animations 
* Side quests with new Toon Alley pals
* More cutscenes and an intro
* Open World access to all levels and side quests
* Save game states
* Suggestions always welcome!
